errors.evidence: The reference description states France is represented by gray (сиво), but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns orange (оранжево) to France.
The reference description states China/continental is represented by orange (оранжево), but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns gray (сиво) to China/continental.
The reference description states Turkey is represented by light green (светлозелено), but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns light blue (светлосиньо) to Turkey.
The reference description mentions that the values for none of the countries change over the period, but the machine-generated description omits this key observation.
The reference description specifies that Spain's values vary around 950 thousand hectares, while the machine-generated description provides a broader and less precise range (900–1000).
The reference does not specify Italy's range, but the figure shows Italy's values are closer to 680–700 thousand hectares, not 600–700 as stated in the machine-generated description.
The reference description explicitly states the order of countries in the legend, but the machine-generated description does not confirm the order matches the visual grouping of bars.
